characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Before entering any space when MOVEing, the Engine can consume an adjacent corpse, wall or hazard, removing it and gaining +1 burst charge. It can do this once per MOVE.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The first foe in the line gains 1 *vulnerable* and 2 or (5+) 3 *guilt*.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: An adjacent *criminal* with 3+ *guilt* takes 1 or (6+) 2 devil damage. If this *obliterates* the *criminal*, the engine feeds on their sin. It may immediately MOVE again and gains +1 burst charge per guilt on the criminal, distributed as it wishes.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Pendulum Swing deals devil damage against criminals with 4+ *guilt*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Pendulum Swing gains +1 maximum range but pushes 1 instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A unit that survives Final Sentence gains 2 *vulnerable*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the end of any turn this unit slays a *criminal*, may gain +2 burst to any ability.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: 1 damage and pull target spaces  equal to their *guilt*. *Criminals* with 3+ *guilt* take 1 fire damage again.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Target foe must choose: gain 1 *vulnerable* and become unable to MOVE until the end of its next turn, or take *piercing* fire damage equal to their *guilt*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When slaying a *criminal*, may replace any corpse they create with a wall.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Chain Grab also has *splash (target)*: pull all criminals 1

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: After pulling a unit, chain grab leaves a hazard in the first space they vacate.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At turn start, may inflict 1 *guilt* on a foe in range 1-3.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Target foe gains 1 *vulnerable*, then is pulled 1 per *guilt*. If it does not end its next turn adjacent to the Clerk, it takes 1 fire damage and 1 *guilt*.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Target unit discards one positive and negative token of your choice, except *guilt*. Create a hazard in a free adjacent space to that unit.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: An ally in range gains +2 or (5+) +3 burst charges, distributed in any manner they choose, but their abilities during their next turn have no effect against any for with less than 3 *guilt*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Deputize immediately allows a unit to step 2, ignoring adverse terrain and elevation penalties.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of this unit's turn, instead of using its regular passive, may move a guilt token from a foe in line of sight to any other foe in line of sight.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this unit is slain, it instead remains at 1 hp and becomes immune to all damage. At the end of its next turn, it is *obliterated*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This unit's MOVE has burst 3. At 0 burst, it cannot MOVE.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Adjacent foe gains 1 *vulnerable* and cannot exit a space adjacent to the Bobby until the Bobby is slain, the Bobby breaks adjacency for any reason, or the start of the Bobby's next turn.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Target a foe in range. For each *guilt* on the target, gain +1 burst charge to any ability and may step 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Bobby has *curseproof* and *MAG* armor against *criminals*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If The Clamps is broken early by a foe, its target gains 2 *guilt*.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Bobby gains +1D on attacks against *criminals*.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Step 1, then push an adjacent unit 2. If target would be pushed into a wall or the edge of the map, they gain 2 *vulnerable*.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: *Splash (self)*: Push 1. All burst abilities gain +1 or (4+) 2 charges.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Screwhead and all adjacent units lose the benefit of all armor.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Roaring reload's splash deals 1 fire damage to *criminals* after push.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Roaring Reload creates a hazard in free adjacent spaces after it resolves.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once a round, you may grant a unit that damages you or an adjacent unit 1 *guilt*.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Foe gains 1 *guilt*, then gains twice as much guilt this turn.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Another ally in range that has not been activated this round may immediately take their turn following this turn.
